description: Kilométrage des types de routes répartis par communes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Simul'impact. Jeu de données produit à partir des données OpenStreetMap française au 18 septembre 2025. Merci de nous contacter pour toute demande de mise à jour. Le script permettant de réaliser le regroupement sera également partagé sous peu. Coverage: Simul'impact. The publisher named on the listing is Simul'impact. Its keywords include open-street-map, routes, communes. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
